Meanwhile...
scene sky
: Hey, Tsuneyo...
: That is the name I was given.
: Ya ever wonder why we’re here?
: It’s one of life’s great mysteries, isn’t it? Why are we here?
: Are we the product of some cosmic coincidence? Or is there really a god watching over everything?
scene mikutsuneyobeach1
: ...Huh? No, like...why are we on the beach? Why don’t we ever go anywhere else? Aren’t there plenty’a places we could take the class to unwind for a weekend?
: Oh.
: The heck was all that stuff about God?
: Likely one more allusion to a long-forgotten relic of the early 2000’s.
scene mikutsuneyobeach2
: The heck you know about the early 2000’s? Ain’t you-
: Don’t say it. Someone will file a complaint.
: Yer’ bein’ weird as hell today. The sun doin’ this to you? Do we gotta head back inside already?
: All we’ll find inside is a separate sun. We are better off out here, where the larger one can make our bodies more desirable to the opposite sex.
: Uh-
: Or the same sex if you are Lebanese.
scene mikutsuneyobeach3
: Is that where you’re from? Always forget that ain’t everybody from Kumon-mi.
: I was born here, just as you were. It is my mother who dared to venture outside the confines of this city.
: But I suppose it would not technically count as venturing as she was born in Egypt and did not travel there.
: You ever gonna go over there? When the walls are all gone and whatnot.
scene mikutsuneyobeach4
: Do you think they ever will be?
: Do you not?
: Not in our lifetimes, I don’t imagine. There’s been no sign at all of them coming down — nor is there much of a reason for it if you really stop and think about it.
scene mikutsuneyobeach5
: For real?! Ya mean I’ll never get to see Brazil?!
: Nor will I ever get to see Virginia. Such a shame. But there is simply nothing that can be done about it.
Tsuneyo Tojo masturbated for the first time last weekend. Or attempted to, at least.
And while this is a strange time to inform you of such an occurrence, I can’t imagine any other that would make any more sense. And it will be relevant information going forward.
You see, Tsuneyo Tojo, sheltered as she is, has been emerging from her shell ever since her first unintentional bout with exhibitionism. It’s something she had in common with the girl beside her.
Granted, that girl had never wandered out into the middle of the road in her birthday suit, chanting about apostates and what to do with them.
And how could she? She didn’t even know what an “apostate” was. But that’s the only currently relevant information in regard to her masturbatory habits (which have seen a recent incline).
For Tsuneyo, though, such a thing was confusing. But not in that pubescent sort of way where you’re still trying to figure out how your body works.
It was confusing for her because the same several figures kept appearing in her head. Her father, her teacher (former), and a man she saw planting a tree once.
Thinking about her father in such context made her uncomfortable, so she shirked those feelings almost immediately. And the thoughts of the man with the tree were no more welcome.
Regardless, they would creep back into her mind at unwanted intervals as she imagined the impure things they’d do to her body.
As she clumsily fidgeted with her inexperienced bud, she found the most pleasure in recalling nights spent with her teacher. But even that was not enough to take her where she needed.
So after approximately seventeen minutes, she gave up on the endeavor and decided to keep such a thing secret for the foreseeable future.
Which probably means I shouldn’t tell you. But again — relevant information. You still with me?
Tsuneyo Tojo is something that we in the office call a “cottontail.” But no, not like the rabbit (despite how greatly you may wish to repeatedly breed her at this point in time).
We call them cottontails strictly because girls like her are exceptional when it comes to avoiding predation, but somewhat lack in terms of mental capacity, often mistaking what to avoid.
Such girls are born when a greater power mates with a lesser one. And there are several others you may also be familiar with.
To anyone else, I’m sure they look like normal girls. But to me, a person experienced in dealing with them, they’re anything but. In fact, they’re really special.
We can bottle their blood to cure cancer, but have been told we’re not allowed to do that since it messes with the circle of life.
Additionally, they excrete a special fluid from the glands inside of their vaginae that makes sexual intercourse marginally more enjoyable for male partners.
The last and most important factoid in regard to what makes the cottontail special is their relation to the seedbed. But you already know what that is-
Wait, you don’t?
Hm. Okay. That makes things a little more difficult. But I’ll try to break it down for you in the easiest way possible.
Each one of us has a number. Think of it like a rating that determines how closely related we are to “God.” So you can think of the seedbed as like...an airport lounge!
It’s a lounge that only people with certain ratings can reach, and the cottontails are among that ilk.
Unfortunately, due to the nature of their existence, most of them are completely unaware that such lounges exist, electing to live out peaceful lives in fictional Japanese cities instead.
So yeah! Basically, she’s special.
BUT SHE WILL NEVER KNOW HOW SPECIAL SHE IS UNLESS YOU FORCE-FEED HER THE INFORMATION REQUIRED TO PROGRESS BEYOND THE-
scene mikutsuneyobeach6
ERROR CODE 57a-3yh8: AUTO-PILOT has malfunctioned. Irrelevant and/or incorrect information has been provided and should be discarded to prevent confusion/contradiction.
///////////RECALIBRATING...
scene mikutsuneyobeach7
///////////RECALIBRATION SUCCESSFUL
: By any chance, were you just sucked into a terrifying liminal space that bordered between “utterly incomprehensible” and “romantically mystifying?”
: I ain’t really sure. I just started thinkin’ about whales a whole lot.
: That happens to me sometimes as well.
scene mikutsuneyobeach8
: Anyway, what were we talking about again? I can’t seem to remember.
: Me neither. Maybe somethin’ about how there ain’t enough tan girls in our class and how everybody should go outside a little more?
: If I become any darker, Miss Imai may mistake me for her daughter. And she already stares at me more than I am comfortable with.
: Everybody stares at ya, Tsuneyo. You’ve got that cool “exotic” look to ya. I do it too and I don’t even like girls. Probably.
scene mikutsuneyobeach9
: I’m not sure I enjoy being referred to as “exotic.”
: Just meant ‘yer different from everybody else.
: I’m not sure that’s any better.
: Yeah, I’m diggin’ myself into a hole here, ain’t I?
scene mikutsuneyobeach10
: It is fine. I know you mean no harm. You would not have invited me to bathe in sunlight with you if you harbored any ill-intent as I could kill you with just one hand.
: Yeah, exactly!
scene mikutsuneyobeach11
: But mostly, I just felt kinda weird bein’ in the room with Io and you were the closest person I could drag along that ain’t named Uta.
: I was under the impression you and the green one were friends?
: I ain’t really sure, to be honest. Like, I thought so too! But she’s been all sorts’a unfriendly lately and I got no idea why. Maybe I said somethin’ weird?
: Did it involve apostates, by any chance?
scene mikutsuneyobeach12
: A pasta? It ain’t noodle time again, is it?
: It’s always noodle time.

scene mikutsuneyobeach14
Further down the shore, a dark entity approaches.
scene mikutsuneyobeach15
The dark entity is Rin.
: Well, well, well — If it isn’t Otoha Okakura, my totally loyal ex-girlfriend who is definitely still respectful of me even though we are now broken up.
scene mikutsuneyobeach16
: Huh? Wha-
scene mikutsuneyobeach17
: Oh. Hey, Rin. Sorry, you don’t normally sneak up on me like that. What’s up?
: Should I redo my greeting? Were you not listening?
: Sorry. My mind is kinda elsewhere right now.
: Hey, that’s totally fine. I get it. Just let me know when the best time to confront you about you sending my nudes to other people is and I’ll come right back.
scene mikutsuneyobeach18
: Yeah. I know about that now.
: Don’t worry. I’ve got all the time in the world for you to come up with an excuse now that I don’t have to spend an entire beach trip waiting for you to text me again.
scene mikutsuneyobeach19
: Hah...
scene black
: You should probably sit down for this...
scene mikutsuneyobeach20
: It’s going to be really hard to stay pissed off while we’re sitting on a banana boat, so be quick.
: Fine. If you want the quick version, I suck and I’m a terrible person who made a terrible decision because that’s all I ever do. And I apologize for being that way and betraying you.
: Nevermind. That wasn’t satisfying enough. Give me the long version and I’ll just deal with the banana thing internally.
: I mean...well...what do you know already?
: I know that Sensei has now seen my boobs twice and that neither of those times he has had permission to do that.
: What the fuck happened the first time?
scene mikutsuneyobeach21
: Does that really matter right now?! How could you do this to me?! I trusted you!
: I know! I know you trusted me! And I know how terrible what I did is, so just...tell me what to do and I’ll do it, okay?! I’m seriously, seriously sorry!
scene mikutsuneyobeach22
: Otoha, I don’t want you to do anything. It’s hard enough just looking at you when, like...feelings still exist and stuff. I just don’t get it. So I want to understand.
: I get that we’re broken up now, but...it was amicable for the most part, wasn’t it? Do you seriously care so little for me that you’d just...put me out there like it’s nothing?
: Rin, I know it’s probably hard to believe, but I really do care for you- okay? You were the first person I did any of that stuff with. And you’ll always be that person for me.
: Like, fifty years from now, I’m still going to think about you when looking back on all of that. So this isn’t, like...me hating you or anything even close to that.
scene mikutsuneyobeach23
: Then why?...
: What were you thinking?
: Otoha...I deserve to know. You’ve gotta give me that, at least.
: I wasn’t thinking, okay? I was...horny.
: The fuck were you horny around Sensei for? You guys have literally never been like that around each other.
: He...had something I wanted. So I kind of...you know...
: Gave me up in exchange for it?...
scene mikutsuneyobeach24
: Rin, I am really sorry. Like, you can straight up just send all of my nudes to him if it’ll make you feel any better. I deserve it.
: I can’t do that, Otoha.
: If it’s because of loyalty, you-
scene mikutsuneyobeach25
: No, I mean I literally can’t. I deleted all of them in a fit of rage after we broke up.
scene mikutsuneyobeach26
: But I wouldn’t have done that either way because it wouldn’t solve anything. Revenge isn’t going to help me at all when I just want to get it.
: Rin-
: What’d he have that you wanted so badly?...
: Who was it?...
scene mikutsuneyobeach27
: I...can’t tell you that. I’m sorry.
: Do I know her?
: I mean...yeah. Everyone knows her. But-
: Does she go to our school? Because I’ve spent a lot of time looking at boobs, Otoha. And those were boobs I didn’t recognize. But Sensei doesn’t talk to girls in other classes and I don’t know-
: It’s just...
: Some girl I’ve had a crush on for a really long time. That’s all I can tell you.
scene mikutsuneyobeach28
: And...she’s never even considered me, so...I kind of jumped at the only opportunity I figured I’d ever have.
: How long?
: ...Long.
: While we were together?
: Since...before we were together.
: So I wasn’t the first girl you ever fell for.
: You were the first one I ever...did stuff with.
: You told me you loved me, Otoha. Do you seriously think you can just...do that while secretly pining for someone else?
scene mikutsuneyobeach29
: Rin, you did the same thing!
: I did not! I never even considered being with anyone but you while we were together!
: You did, though! Even if you didn’t try to make anything happen!
: Otoha, Chika and I are just friends! And I get why you don’t like her, but-
: I’m talking about Sensei!
scene mikutsuneyobeach30
: You fell for him way before you fell for me. You just refuse to accept that for...whatever reason. Probably because he’s old and creepy. It’s the truth, though. And you know it.
: I don’t-
: When I had to compete against Sana in that confession contest, do you remember what you said to me? Do you remember how easily you were able to come up with a confession to him?
scene mikutsuneyobeach31
: Yeah! But that doesn’t mean I-
: Rin, I know you better than most people. And I spent more than enough time with you to understand that there’s only one person you ever feel truly “right” with.
: That was never me. You were never fully truthful to me. You think I didn’t notice that you were still cutting when we were together?
scene mikutsuneyobeach32
: Because I didn’t want you to think it was your fault when it wasn’t!
: You don’t have to explain it to me! I knew you had Sensei and I knew you could talk to him about it if you really had to. But that’s just the thing, Rin.
scene mikutsuneyobeach33
: You will bare everything for him. And you can try to shut him out as much as you want, but if he seriously wanted to run away with you, you’d do it in a heartbeat and you know it.
: That’s what it’s like for me too. But the difference there is that the person I want won’t ever want me back. And Sensei does want you. He just...wants a lot more than that too.
scene mikutsuneyobeach34
: Listen...I’m not saying all this to justify why I did what I did. I have colossally fucked up and probably made it so you’ll never want to talk to me again after today.
: But even if I can’t make this any better, maybe I can let you know that it’s okay for you to feel the way you do.
: No...it’s not.
: Rin...someone I look up to used to write about how we can’t help who we fall for...and that sometimes we long for the wrong people. But that doesn’t make those feelings fake.
: If anything, it makes them stronger. It challenges you. And the only thing you’ll gain by just sidelining those feelings is regret.
: There’s regret involved either way. Someone’s going to get hurt no matter what happens.
: Then make sure it’s somebody else and not you.
scene mikutsuneyobeach35
: Otoha-
: You deserve to be happy more than anyone else I know. And if you can’t forgive yourself for that, then I will.
: And yeah- my word probably means little to nothing at this point. But it’s all I have, so I’ll give it to you.
scene mikutsuneyobeach36
: Can you just...
scene mikutsuneyobeach37
: Can you just...delete any other photos you have of me? Please?
: I already did. I felt way too gross after sending that one to Sensei and didn’t want to create a situation where I could just keep doing it.
: Cool...thanks.
scene mikutsuneyobeach38
: That’s...all I wanted to say. I’m gonna go try to find Futaba or something.
: Rin-
: Thanks for...all of that, Otoha.
: I’m still pissed at you, though.
scene black
: No problem...I’d be shocked if you weren’t.
: And, uhh...
: I hope...your thing works out too.
: It won’t.
: Yeah...
: But I hope it will.
